description: C2 import/export roundtrip - the n8n workflow JSON is imported into a disposable local m9m, read back and exported. The shared deployment is never written to.

cases.name: C2 Simple Webhook: n8n JSON -> local m9m import -> GET -> export
cases.notes: typeVersion is excluded because m9m stores it as an int (documented model limitation, asserted separately by the C6 typeVersion contract). Nodes, parameters, credentials and connections must survive the roundtrip.

cases.notes: Second roundtrip fixture with a Set node and its parameter tree.
